# Decision Bets Lab

> A learning sandbox inspired by Annie Duke's "Thinking in Bets". Frame decisions as explicit bets, assign probabilities to outcomes, and separate decision quality from outcome quality.

Decision Bets Lab is a free, single-page web app for founders, operators, investors, and learners who want to make better decisions under uncertainty. It runs entirely in the browser with no account required.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, presets, and how the lab works.
- [Lab](/lab): Interactive sandbox to frame a decision, assign probabilities, record reasoning, and review outcomes.
- [About](/about): Decision quality vs outcome quality, the "resulting" bias, and how to use the lab.
